title: Pai vs Chiang Mai: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Chiang Mai for culture, food, and variety; Pai for mountain scenery and slow travel. Do Chiang Mai first, then side-trip to Pai for 2-3 nights.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Chiang Mai has one of SE Asia's best food scenes — khao soi, night markets, cooking classes. Pai has a charming Walking Street but limited depth.

categories.name: Nature & Outdoors
categories.summary: Pai wins for mountain valley scenery, Pai Canyon, bamboo bridges, hot springs, and waterfalls all within 30 minutes of town.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Pai is 20-30% cheaper for accommodation. Bungalows from ฿300/night ($8). But Chiang Mai's paid experiences offer better value per baht.

categories.name: Temples & Culture
categories.summary: Chiang Mai has 300+ temples and deep Lanna cultural heritage. Pai has 2-3 local temples and a backpacker/hippie-dominated scene.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Chiang Mai has multiple bar streets and venues. Pai has a specific cannabis/hippie party scene that appeals to a niche audience.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Chiang Mai: elephant sanctuaries, Doi Inthanon, Chiang Rai. Pai: Mae Hong Son, Tham Lod Cave, waterfalls. Chiang Mai's roster is stronger.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Chiang Mai has direct flights from Bangkok (1h), Singapore, KL. Pai requires 3-4 hours by minivan over 762 mountain curves from Chiang Mai.

categories.name: Digital Nomads
categories.summary: Chiang Mai is a top-10 digital nomad city globally. Pai has limited coworking and unreliable WiFi.

faq.question: Is Pai or Chiang Mai better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Chiang Mai. It's a major city with depth, easy connections, and a week's worth of activities. Pai is best as a 2-3 day side trip.

faq.question: How far is Pai from Chiang Mai?
faq.answer: 135 km, 3-4 hours by minivan over 762 mountain curves. Scenic but causes motion sickness — take Dramamine.
